summary.text: Campus life at NIT Warangal is coordinated by the Dean (Student Welfare) through the Student Activity Centre, which organises activity under three umbrella bodies on the Student Council: the Technical, Cultural, and Film & Music Societies, each running specialised clubs from robotics and ham radio to debating, photography, and dance-drama. The Centre for Sports Activities maintains a full stadium complex and runs freshers' tournaments feeding into the annual Inter-NIT Sports Meet. The calendar's two flagship festivals are Technozion, a technical fest held every October since 2006, and Spring Spree, a cultural fest tracing back to 1978 and held every February.
